title: XP bonus ceiling + GM console powers

changes.before: Gear XP capped at +40%, but the guild XP perk (up to +40%) and party XP bonus (up to +40%) multiplied on top — a fully geared, guilded party player could reach +120% XP.
changes.after: One +40% ceiling over gear + guild perk + party bonus combined. Tooltips still show true gear totals; the cap applies at gain time.
changes.note: Staff-run event buffs (double-XP weekends) still multiply on top — that's their purpose.

changes.before: Grants, set-values, dossier, mute, ban/kick; no record of what staff did.
changes.after: New: server-side staff audit log (survives restarts), full target inventory browser with per-item enchant set + removal, equipped-item enchant control, daily/weekly quest re-roll, and server-wide event buffs (1–10x XP/gold with expiry, announced to players at login). Every grant/ban/mute/kick is now audit-logged.
changes.note: GM powers only; normal players see nothing.

changes.before: 11 animated scenes (16 backgrounds in the Settings picker).
changes.after: 15 animated scenes. All 7 new scenes (Frostfall, Starfall, Blood Moon, Night Sky, Sunset, Woods, Water) now use photorealistic generated art with a slow cinematic Ken Burns drift and a soft vignette, instead of procedural canvas drawing. Art is compressed to ~872KB total so phones stay light. Pickable in Settings → Background and usable in battle through the 🖼️ My background card.
changes.note: Balance-neutral: visuals only. Respects Reduce Motion and Performance Mode (static frame).

changes.before: 3 earnable sets: Emberheart, Frostbound, Stormcaller (1% drop from any boss kill).
changes.after: 6 earnable sets. Added 🩸 Bloodmoon Regalia (lifesteal/regen — 3pc: +10 lifesteal; 5pc: +20 lifesteal, +15 regen), 💰 Gilded Fortune (gold/XP — 3pc: +40% gold from kills; 5pc: +80% gold, +40% XP), 🌑 Nightfall Shroud (crit/dodge — 3pc: +35% crit damage; 5pc: +70% crit damage, +8% dodge).
changes.note: Same 1% drop chance from any boss kill; regular enemies never drop set pieces. Existing sets untouched.

changes.before: 8 animated scenes (13 backgrounds in the Settings picker).
changes.after: 11 animated scenes. Added ❄️ Frostfall (drifting snow, glinting ice shards), ☄️ Starfall (meteor streaks over a twinkling starfield), 🌕 Blood Moon (giant red moon, drifting fog, rising ash). Pickable in Settings → Background and usable in battle through the 🖼️ My background card.

changes.before: The sky flash drew, but the bolt line hit an undefined variable and never rendered (console error each strike).
changes.after: The bolt draws correctly on every lightning strike.
120 — Rebirth now unlocks at 120. All gates (title check, rebirth, UI) follow MAX_LEVEL.
changes.note: Rebirth still resets only level/XP and keeps all other progress.

changes.after: Levels 91-120 continue from the level-90 value with a x1.47 exponent, continuous at 90. Level 100 costs ~3.48e15 XP, level 120 ~7.72e18 XP; level 120 is ~104,600x the level-90 cost. Total XP 1->120 is ~98,000x total 1->90, so the last 30 levels are a proper endgame grind.
changes.note: Levels 1-90 are unchanged. A raw x1.46-1.48 segment could never hit a 5-8x total target, so the new band is deliberately the steepest — the 91-120 climb stays honest even with the +40% party bonus.

changes.before: Enemy HP = 18 x 1.125^stage (x0.6 normal, x2.5 boss).
changes.after: Enemy HP = 18 x 1.115^stage (x0.6 normal, x2.5 boss).
changes.note: The flatter exponent cuts enemy HP ~9x at stage 250, ~15x at stage 300, and ~1,265x by stage 800 vs 1.125. Early game untouched (already one-taps), and the boss x2.5 multiplier plus incoming-damage auto-tuning (15-30% max HP hits, one-shot guard) still hold.

changes.after: 1-30 unchanged (80 x 1.30^(L-1)); 31-60 use x1.35 exponent; 61-90 use x1.44 exponent, continuous at both kinks. Level 60 needs ~3.1x more XP than before, level 70 ~3.6x, level 90 ~4.7x.
changes.note: Targets the 30-70 climb players called too fast. Early game (1-30) untouched so new players still feel quick progress. Even with a full +40% party XP bonus, level 70 still takes ~2.5x longer than before.

changes.after: Up to +40% XP from parties: +8% per other online human, +4% per active NPC companion. Offline members give nothing.
changes.note: The v18 XP curve was steepened with this bonus active in the math, so parties speed you up without trivializing the climb.
Lowered to offset the new party XP bonus stacking on top.

changes.after: 90 — Rebirth now unlocks at 90. The steepened XP curve runs the full 1-90 range.
changes.note: Rebirth still resets only level/XP and keeps all other progress.
